shortDescription: One plugin to install Anran and connect it to supported Agents.
longDescription: Install or restore Anran as a native Kimi Pet, or connect the same Anran to WorkBuddy, vBuddy, Qwen and Doubao. The native installer copies Anran and its resources into Anran-owned stable storage, so installed hosts do not depend on Kimi's plugin directory. No separate MCP product or manual runtime archive is required. Supported hosts share lifecycle, right-click and persistent drag-position behavior, subject to real host verification.
tryPrompts: Install Anran on my desktop now

anran-pet.description: Install Anran and connect it to supported Agents from one plugin.
